stages.name: Nursery & Early Vegetative
stages.critical_needs: Maintain 2cm water depth. Do not submerge seedling tips.
stages.fertilizer_window: Basal DAP application completed before transplanting.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: Ensure surplus nursery drainage. Submerged seedlings die if waterlogged > 4 days.

stages.name: Active Tillering & Panicle Initiation
stages.critical_needs: Top-dressing with Urea (25kg/acre) and MOP Potash (12.5kg/acre). High nitrogen demand.
stages.fertilizer_window: Urea top-dressing ONLY on dry soil with standing water < 2cm. STRICTLY postpone if rainfall > 15mm is forecast.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: CRITICAL: If heavy rain (>20mm in 24h) is forecast, cancel fertilizer broadcast immediately. Urea will leach into canals. Clear secondary field trenches.

stages.name: Flowering & Milk Stage
stages.critical_needs: Crucial moisture stage. High wind (>35 km/h) causes lodging and sterile spikelets.
stages.fertilizer_window: Foliar spray of 1% Potassium chloride or 2% DAP in clear weather.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: Avoid foliar spraying during cloudy or rainy days. Inspect for false smut or neck blast disease after continuous wet spell.

stages.name: Dough & Grain Hardening
stages.critical_needs: Gradual field de-watering. Grains turning golden yellow.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: Open field bund drains 10-14 days before expected harvest. Prevent standing water from causing grain pre-germination on the panicle.

stages.name: Physiological Maturity & Harvest
stages.critical_needs: Harvesting with combine harvester or manual sickle. Grain moisture target: 18-20%.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: URGENT HARVEST DECISION: If cyclonic storm or rain > 25mm is predicted within 48h and crop is 85% golden, harvest immediately with tracked harvesters. If rain has started, postpone harvest until field surface dries to avoid harvester bogging.

stages.name: Vegetative & Branching
stages.critical_needs: Extremely sensitive to waterlogging. Roots rot within 24 hours of ponding.
stages.fertilizer_window: Foliar spray of 2% DAP at 30 DAS.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: Open drainage channels at 2-metre intervals. Pulse crops cannot tolerate standing water.

stages.name: Flowering & Pod Filling
stages.critical_needs: Dry weather preferred for pod maturation.
stages.fertilizer_window: Pulse wonder foliar spray (2kg/acre) on sunny mornings.
stages.monsoon_risk_action: Excess rain causes vegetative re-growth and rotting of pods on the ground.

safety_prohibitions.rule_explanation: Applying nitrogenous fertilizers or synthetic chemical sprays within 24 hours of heavy rainfall results in chemical runoff into local water bodies, zero plant uptake, and severe economic waste.
